title: Ski Lodge Murder Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure) omitted by convention; Sonoko Suzuki is kept because she is a direct victim of the culprit's staged assault, not just a bystander. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved. Culprit Akiko Yonehara disguises herself as an early victim of the 'attacker' by chloroforming/bruising herself and posing Sugiyama's already-strangled corpse in her own bed with a matching lipstick mark, which is why her only role tag is 'suspect' (never 'victim', despite the in-story deception) per schema convention. The rope marks initially attributed to an attack on Yonehara actually belong to Sugiyama's corpse from his earlier real strangulation. case_type: murder.

attrs.mechanism: line wrapped around the two pillars by the door and tied to a rubber band looped on Sugiyama's stiffened neck; the cold snaps the rubber band after a measured delay so the propped-up corpse falls and rings the doorbell, then the line blows away
attrs.corroboration: Conan rebuilds and demonstrates the same rig on a ski to prove it works

clues.desc: Lipstick letters left on three different people/bodies -- 'mi' on the corpse posed as Yonehara, 'na' on Sonoko's hand, 'ko' on Sugiyama's own hand -- only make sense combined as the name 'Minako', tying all three incidents to one motive.

Icicles had already formed near the lodge's heater by the time the group arrived, which could only happen if the heater had been running for hours -- proof someone was in the lodge, alive or moving a body, well before the official arrival time.
Blood recovered from the wig's hair matches scratch wounds on Shimoda's neck, directly tying the wig (not a rope) to his strangulation.
